name: Browse a real marketplace with no seeded products
description: Verifies the public marketplace starts empty and only shows genuine approved seller listings.
steps: Open the marketplace home page before any seller has published a listing
Open Search and view all categories
After a seller listing is approved, refresh the marketplace
expected: The initial marketplace shows the no-products message with no mock items; only the newly approved seller listing appears after approval.

name: Passwordless sign-in and protected buyer data
description: Verifies a buyer can sign in by email link and protected account data is tied to the signed-in identity.
steps: Create a buyer account using the email sign-in link
Open Profile and save a listing
Log out and attempt to open Saved items
expected: The buyer profile and saved products are available to the authenticated user and the session is cleared on logout.

name: Seller submits listing with calculated fee and receipt
covers: seller profile and Nigerian phone normalization
receipt image upload and duplicate prevention
description: Verifies the seller sees the product price, exact 10 percent listing fee and configured bank details before submitting proof of payment.
steps: Create a seller account with a Nigerian WhatsApp number
Open Sell and enter a product price of 20000 naira
Confirm the listing fee shows 2000 naira, then upload photos and a receipt and submit
expected: The listing is created as Pending, the fee is calculated as 10 percent of the intended price, and it remains hidden from public search until approval.

name: Admin receives submission alert and approves seller listing
description: Verifies an admin who enabled alerts is notified of a new pending listing and approval publishes it and notifies the seller.
steps: Sign in to a Danzo account, open /admin and unlock admin
Enable admin alerts on the device
As a separate seller account, submit a listing
Confirm the admin receives the new-listing notification and approves the pending listing
Open the public marketplace and the seller's My Listings updates
expected: The approved listing appears in public browsing immediately and the seller receives a verified/live notification in the app and by push when enabled.

name: Report listing and enforce seller ownership
description: Verifies buyer reports are recorded and private contact information is withheld from logged-out visitors.
steps: Sign in as a buyer and submit a report
Open a product while logged out
Attempt to edit a listing owned by another account
expected: The report is queued for review, logged-out visitors see a login-to-contact prompt, and cross-account edits are denied.
